findings.claim: Accepting both Meta and Control on every platform exceeds the selected browser-link contract and can steal a modifier-owned mouse event from the terminal.
findings.evidence: The helper now selects Meta only on Mac and Control elsewhere; widening it to either modifier fails four inverse tests.
findings.path: physical modifier -> shared helper -> anchor click and SGR mouse press

findings.claim: Without blur and destroy cleanup, the underline and pointer affordance can remain latched.
findings.evidence: Removing cleanup made the direct blur regression fail; restored cleanup passes release, blur, destroy, and post-destroy listener checks.
findings.path: document key state -> root CSS class -> window blur or WTerm.destroy

findings.claim: The native modifier leaked one SGR mouse report in Chromium.
findings.evidence: The assertion compared cumulative arrays after two events. Measuring per-event deltas showed zero native-modifier reports and one non-native report.
findings.path: Meta press snapshot -> Control press snapshot -> per-event delta
